result.note: Mostly US party politics and a leaked recording; only the August 2025 US tariff action on India is a durable, testable fact.

questions.prompt: In August 2025, the United States doubled tariffs on Indian goods to 50%. The additional 25% tariff was imposed over which of the following?
options: India's imports of Russian crude oil
India's levy of a digital services tax
India's high duties on US motorcycles
India's restrictions on US dairy imports
questions.explain: The extra 25% tariff was tied to India's purchases of Russian crude, taking the total to 50%. In January 2026, a leaked recording had Senator Ted Cruz saying he was battling the White House to accept a trade deal with India.
questions.source: In August 2025, Trump doubled tariffs on Indian goods to 50%, adding a 25% tariff over India’s Russian crude imports.
